about: Evidence for the EIP-7702 delegates app/src/finance/delegates.ts recognizes, and for the ones it does not. Read-only measurements, 25 Sep 2026.
source: eth_getCode, eth_call and eth_getStorageAt through the own Nitro node (SSH tunnel); Sourcify API v2 for verified sources; public RPC endpoints of other chains for code comparison.

sample.description: Delegates of the accounts that received a Uniswap v4 PositionManager NFT in the 6,048,000 blocks (169.3 hours) before block 71,510,559, measured on 24 Sep 2026.
